method_feedback.rule_or_skill: skills/register/SKILL.md, Procedures 1, 3 and 7; register/REGISTER_RULES.md RG-01

additional_evidence: register/profile.json names cited literature and lists 42 documents, including the QIP slides and two certificate-complexity editions.

method_feedback.problem: The method already requires genre matching, a declared edition and prose-region matching. The packet exports a broad mixed profile as its measurement context without carrying the distinct matched comparison that the revision account says was used. A reviewer cannot readily tell which numbers guided which editorial choices. This is not evidence that the writer never used matched sources.
method_feedback.general_advice: Give each exported measurement a role: primary matched comparison, whole-document context or broad shelf context. Ship its declared documents, editions, prose scopes and exclusions with it; retain the broad profile only under its own role.
method_feedback.boundary: Do not discard research papers as qualitative comparisons, and do not force a common numerical target on exposition and research prose.

method_feedback.rule_or_skill: skills/register/SKILL.md, Procedure 3; register/REGISTER_RULES.md RG-01

method_feedback.problem: The existing rule already says to inspect extraction and exclude damaged text. method_feedback.evidence_kind: Agent editorial analysis; proposed method refinement, not a measured learning effect.

method_feedback.rule_or_skill: skills/record-to-expository/SKILL.md, Procedures 1, 3 and 6; register/REGISTER_RULES.md RG-05 and RG-08
method_feedback.title: Distinguish mechanism-critical scales from loose arithmetic on the reading route

additional_evidence: The exact r, gamma and cap roles determine why the algorithms work; the loose logarithmic power six and routine floor estimates are needed for a precise family statement but teach a different level of detail.
method_feedback.problem: Preserving every constant does not require giving every constant the same narrative weight. The current count is correct, yet the final mechanism can be obscured by routine arithmetic at the payoff.
method_feedback.general_advice: Retain exact quantitative statements and their accessible derivations, while identifying which scale makes the construction work and which is slack in the displayed estimate. Let the main route return promptly to the strict exponent gap.

method_feedback.rule_or_skill: skills/record-to-expository/SKILL.md, Procedures 6 and 8; reader_principles.md 12–14
